notes.text: Tom's names the GPU but not the card model. It says it uses reference cards (Nvidia Founders Edition, AMD reference designs) where possible, and cards close to reference specs otherwise.
Tom's says it tests on "a frozen version of Windows 11" and does not give the build.
Tom's says it standardizes on one graphics driver version per vendor for its 2026 test plan but does not name the versions.
Tom's does not state the game version; its 2026 test-plan article says games can update during testing and results are spot-checked when they do.
Tom's uses its own gameplay sequences of about 60 seconds, captured with FrameView "with limited exceptions", and does not describe the scene for each game.
This is the raster chart, labelled "(DX12)"; Tom's charts its ray-traced runs separately, labelled "(DXR)".
Tom's 2026 hierarchy is tested at native resolution without DLSS, FSR or XeSS, and without frame generation.
Tom's "1% Low" bar, printed as a whole number on the chart; the page does not define the metric.

The hierarchy page is updated over time. publishedAt is its last update (dateModified 2026-06-24T21:35:42Z; our UTC+3 capture shows "Last updated June 25, 2026"), and Tom's says the game charts are "up to date as of June 2026".
